title: DKIM signed-header set hardcoded in 3 places
description: The list ["From", "To", "Subject", "Date", "Message-ID", "MIME-Version"] is hardcoded in smtp/src/main.rs, reader/src/store/server_stores.rs (build_smtp_relay_queue), and the test helper in relay_queue.rs. DKIM signer construction is also copy-pasted across these sites. If an operator needs to add a header (e.g. List-Id, Reply-To) to the signed set, they must update three locations. A contributor will copy the pattern and create a fourth. Fix: define a const DKIM_SIGNED_HEADERS in stoa_smtp::config or a helper fn build_dkim_signer(DkimConfig) -> DkimSigner.
